badge.name: Loved by Guests
badge.subtitle: Top 10% of guest reviews in this area

reviews.body: Villa del Sol was beyond perfection for our executive retreat! The backyard pool and patio were magnificent, and the bedrooms were spacious and spotless. We will definitely be back.

host_response.body: Thank you so much Sarah! It was our pleasure hosting your team.

reviews.title: Exceptional luxury stay in Tempe
reviews.body: Exceptional property in a quiet Tempe neighborhood. Kitchen was fully stocked and the outdoor grill was top notch. A minor issue with one of the secondary bathroom door locks was quickly attended to.

host_response.body: Thank you David! We appreciate your feedback and had our handyman adjust the bathroom latch right away.

reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay with our extended family. The kids loved the pool and games room. Front door lock buttons felt sluggish in afternoon heat, but host gave clear instructions.

reviews.title: Perfect summer getaway with friends
reviews.body: Spacious layout, beautiful pool, and very responsive host. Blender was a bit leaky when making smoothies, but everything else was 5-star quality. Highly recommend!

host_response.body: Thank you Rachel! We've replaced the blender pitcher and gasket. Hope to see you again next summer!

reviews.title: Unrivaled VIP experience
reviews.body: Direct booking through Kivoya was seamless. The estate exceeded all expectations for our corporate leadership meeting. The backyard resort pool is unmatched in the East Valley.

Outstanding stay! The heated pool and outdoor gazebo made our family reunion unforgettable. Host was very responsive. The pool heat had an issue on day 1 but host dispatched the technician within 2 hours.

host_response.body: Thank you James! We resolved that pool heat pump breaker immediately and are glad your family enjoyed the rest of your vacation.

reviews.title: Luxury oasis in Tempe
reviews.body: We celebrated our 40th anniversary here with 14 family members. Ample parking, immaculate bedrooms, and a kitchen built for entertaining. Worth every penny.

reviews.title: Superb luxury property
reviews.body: Spacious, clean, and beautifully appointed. Outdoor heated pool was 86 degrees and fantastic for the chilly spring evenings. The Kivoya staff was courteous and attentive.
